subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 A poor girl, named Anju worked in a rich man's house. The house master was kind to her but the mistress was very cruel. She used to scold her now and then. One day while serving tea, Anju broke a cup of tea. At this the mistress got furious and started beating the poor girl. The girl was crying lonely. A friend of the mistress was waiting in the living room. The girl's cry got to her notice ........................
guide_solution: Story writing  Title : Life of a Housemaid See Rajshahi Collegiate School. Sl. No. 22; Page No. 70
